tasks.label: pdq-metadata-check
args: $urls=@('https://app.pdq.com/.well-known/openid-configuration','https://app.pdq.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server'); foreach($u in $urls){ try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $u -Method Get -TimeoutSec 20; Write-Output ('URL: ' + $u); Write-Output ('Status: ' + [int]$r.StatusCode); Write-Output ('BodySnippet: ' + ($r.Content.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(300,$r.Content.Length)).Replace("`r"," ").Replace("`n"," "))); } catch { Write-Output ('URL: ' + $u); Write-Output ('ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message) } ; Write-Output '---' }

tasks.label: pdq-auth-metadata-live
tasks.command: try { $r = Invoke-WebRequest -Uri 'https://app.pdq.com/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server' -TimeoutSec 20; $j = $r.Content | ConvertFrom-Json; [pscustomobject]@{ issuer=$j.issuer; authorization_endpoint=$j.authorization_endpoint; token_endpoint=$j.token_endpoint; response_types_supported=($j.response_types_supported -join ','); code_challenge_methods_supported=($j.code_challenge_methods_supported -join ','); scopes_supported=($j.scopes_supported -join ',') } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 } catch { 'ERROR: ' + $_.Exception.Message }

tasks.label: pdq-authorize-probe
tasks.command: $base='https://auth2.pdq.com/oauth/authorize'; $client='c9403ceb-ba30-4e2d-9cef-7a2884b7452b'; $redir='http://localhost:3000/oauth/callback'; $state='debugstate'; $cc='abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789ABCDEFG'; $tests=@('openid profile pdq.connect','devices:read groups:read deployments:read'); foreach($scope in $tests){ $uri = "$base?response_type=code&client_id=$([uri]::EscapeDataString($client))&redirect_uri=$([uri]::EscapeDataString($redir))&scope=$([uri]::EscapeDataString($scope))&state=$state&code_challenge=$cc&code_challenge_method=S256"; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Output ('SCOPE='+$scope); Write-Output ('STATUS='+[int]$r.StatusCode) } catch { $resp=$_.Exception.Response; if($resp){ Write-Output ('SCOPE='+$scope); Write-Output ('STATUS='+[int]$resp.StatusCode); try { $sr=[System.IO.StreamReader]::new($resp.GetResponseStream()); $body=$sr.ReadToEnd(); $sr.Dispose(); Write-Output ('BODY='+($body.Substring(0,[Math]::Min(180,$body.Length)).Replace("`r",' ').Replace("`n",' '))) } catch {} } else { Write-Output ('SCOPE='+$scope); Write-Output ('ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message) } }; Write-Output '---' }

tasks.label: port-3000-owner
tasks.command: Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -State Listen -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,@{n='ProcessName';e={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

tasks.label: port-3000-owner-check2
tasks.command: $rows = Get-NetTCPConnection -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if($rows){ $rows | Select-Object State,LocalAddress,LocalPort,OwningProcess,@{n='ProcessName';e={(Get-Process -Id $_.OwningProcess -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue).ProcessName}} | Format-Table -AutoSize } else { 'No active TCP bindings on port 3000.' }

tasks.label: pdq-authorize-status-check
tasks.command: $scope='deployments:read devices:read groups:read'; $uri="https://auth2.pdq.com/oauth/authorize?response_type=code&client_id=c9403ceb-ba30-4e2d-9cef-7a2884b7452b&redirect_uri=http%3A%2F%2Flocalhost%3A3000%2Foauth%2Fcallback&scope=$([uri]::EscapeDataString($scope))&state=diagstate&code_challenge=abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789ABCDEFG&code_challenge_method=S256"; try { $r=Invoke-WebRequest -Uri $uri -MaximumRedirection 0 -ErrorAction Stop; 'STATUS=' + [int]$r.StatusCode } catch { if($_.Exception.Response){ 'STATUS=' + [int]$_.Exception.Response.StatusCode } else { 'ERROR=' + $_.Exception.Message } }

tasks.label: validate-pdq-oauth-helper
tasks.command: Import-Module .\TechToolbox.psd1 -Force; Get-Command Set-TechAgentMcpOAuthCallback | Format-List Name,CommandType,Source; Set-TechAgentMcpOAuthCallback -ServerName pdq-connect -CallbackUrl 'https://auth2.pdq.com/oidc/test/callback?code=abc123&state=xyz' | Format-List *
